name: MonarchStatusPicker
title: StatusPicker
wrapsNative: MonarchButton (androidx.compose.material3.Button) or androidx.compose.material3.IconButton with androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuItem and HorizontalDivider; androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas for the category glyphs
summary: A menu button that shows and changes the workflow status of an issue, task or ticket, with the team's own statuses grouped under five fixed categories, each with its own glyph and name.
whenToUse: In issue rows, cards and detail screens where the status can be changed. Use MonarchStatusGlyph with the status name where the status is shown but not changed.
whenNotToUse: For a read-only status with a tone, use MonarchStatusBadge. For urgency, use MonarchPriorityPicker. For the steps of a form, use MonarchStepper.
api: @Composable fun MonarchStatusPicker(statuses: List<MonarchStatusOption>, value: String?, onValueChange: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchStatusPickerSize = MonarchStatusPickerSize.Md, showLabel: Boolean = true, enabled: Boolean = true, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchStatusPickerLabels = MonarchStatusPickerLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
@Composable fun MonarchStatusGlyph(category: MonarchStatusCategory, modifier: Modifier = Modifier)
enum class MonarchStatusCategory { Backlog, Unstarted, Started, Completed, Cancelled; val isClosed: Boolean }
class MonarchStatusOption(id: String, name: String, category: MonarchStatusCategory)

class MonarchStatusPickerLabels(trigger: ((String) -> String)? = null, none: String? = null, backlog: String? = null, unstarted: String? = null, started: String? = null, completed: String? = null, cancelled: String? = null)

options.name: statuses
options.description: The statuses to choose from. The menu groups them by category, in category order, and keeps their order within a group.

options.name: value
options.description: The id of the current status; null or an id not in statuses shows No status.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the id of the chosen status. Choosing the current status only closes the menu.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm for a dense row or a card, Md for a form. The touch target is 48dp at both sizes.

options.name: showLabel
options.description: Shows the status's name next to its glyph. false gives a glyph-only icon button, still named.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the menu can be opened.

options.name: trailingIcon
options.description: A decorative icon after the name, such as a down chevron. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Status: %s", "No status" and the five category headings.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the trigger's press and focus interactions.

options.name: category
options.description: MonarchStatusGlyph: the category whose glyph is drawn, 14dp by default.

states.name: categories
states.description: Backlog: a dashed ring in the subtle text color. Not started: a ring in the muted text color. In progress: a ring with its end half filled in the strong warning color. Completed: a disc with a check mark in the strong success color. Cancelled: a disc with a cross in the subtle text color.

states.name: menu open
states.description: A Material 3 dropdown menu with a heading per category that has statuses, divided by lines; each status shows its category glyph and name, and the current one is selected and has a radio button.

states.name: no status
states.description: The trigger shows the backlog glyph and "No status"; no menu item is selected.

states.name: glyph only
states.description: An icon button with the glyph; the name stays in what TalkBack reads.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The button's disabled colors; the menu does not open.

appearance: The trigger is a secondary MonarchButton with the category glyph and the status name. Glyphs use the subtle text color for backlog and cancelled, the muted text color for not started, the strong warning color for in progress and the strong success color for completed; the check mark and cross are cut out in the surface color. Menu headings are muted caption text. High contrast themes use their stronger roles.
platformNotes: Built like MonarchPriorityPicker: a Material 3 menu takes any composable as an item's icon, so the web's glyphs are drawn on a Canvas from its 14-unit grid instead of an icon set, which Monarch does not bundle. That is why Android builds a type where iOS documents the system menu Picker with SF Symbols and ships none. The web's DropdownMenuLabel group headings are muted caption headings inside the menu, with a divider between groups, because Material 3 menus have no section API. The web's StatusGlyph is MonarchStatusGlyph, STATUS_CATEGORIES is the order of MonarchStatusCategory, and StatusOption is MonarchStatusOption. The web's sm and md sizes map to the MonarchButton sizes. The half fill of the in-progress glyph does not mirror right to left, as on the web.
accessibility: The trigger has the drop-down list role and is read as "Status: In progress".
In the menu each category heading has the heading role, and each status is read by name; the current one has the selected state and a radio button.
The glyphs are hidden from TalkBack; each category has its own shape and each status its own name, so the status never depends on color alone.
The trigger has a touch target of at least 48dp at both sizes, with or without the name.
The name scales with the font size setting without being cut.
edgeCases: A category with no statuses gets no heading.
A value that is not in statuses reads and looks like null: No status.
Long status names wrap in the trigger; the menu wraps them as any Material 3 menu item.
An empty statuses list opens an empty menu; disable the picker instead.

examples.title: Status picker
examples.template:
MonarchStatusPicker(
    statuses = statuses,
    value = status,
    onValueChange = { status = it },
    initiallyOpen = true,
)
examples.setupTemplate:
val statuses = listOf(
    MonarchStatusOption({{statuses.0.id}}, {{statuses.0.name}}, MonarchStatusCategory.{{statuses.0.category|pascal}}),
    MonarchStatusOption({{statuses.1.id}}, {{statuses.1.name}}, MonarchStatusCategory.{{statuses.1.category|pascal}}),
    MonarchStatusOption({{statuses.2.id}}, {{statuses.2.name}}, MonarchStatusCategory.{{statuses.2.category|pascal}}),
    MonarchStatusOption({{statuses.3.id}}, {{statuses.3.name}}, MonarchStatusCategory.{{statuses.3.category|pascal}}),
    MonarchStatusOption({{statuses.4.id}}, {{statuses.4.name}}, MonarchStatusCategory.{{statuses.4.category|pascal}}),
    MonarchStatusOption({{statuses.5.id}}, {{statuses.5.name}}, MonarchStatusCategory.{{statuses.5.category|pascal}}),
    MonarchStatusOption({{statuses.6.id}}, {{statuses.6.name}}, MonarchStatusCategory.{{statuses.6.category|pascal}}),
)
var status by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>({{value}}) }
examples.setup:
val statuses = listOf(
    MonarchStatusOption("triage", "Triage", MonarchStatusCategory.Backlog),
    MonarchStatusOption("backlog", "Backlog", MonarchStatusCategory.Backlog),
    MonarchStatusOption("todo", "Todo", MonarchStatusCategory.Unstarted),
    MonarchStatusOption("doing", "In progress", MonarchStatusCategory.Started),
    MonarchStatusOption("review", "In review", MonarchStatusCategory.Started),
    MonarchStatusOption("done", "Done", MonarchStatusCategory.Completed),
    MonarchStatusOption("dropped", "Won’t do", MonarchStatusCategory.Cancelled),
)
var status by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>("doing") }
examples.code:
MonarchStatusPicker(
    statuses = statuses,
    value = status,
    onValueChange = { status = it },
    initiallyOpen = true,
)

examples.title: A glyph-only picker in a dense row
examples.code:
MonarchStatusPicker(
    statuses = statuses,
    value = status,
    onValueChange = { status = it },
    size = MonarchStatusPickerSize.Sm,
    showLabel = false,
)
